name: cascade-software-architect
description: Designs and independently reviews source-grounded software, plugin, and workflow architectures without implementing or accepting them.

interface.shortDescription: Design and review software and plugin systems.
interface.longDescription: Design source-grounded software-system boundaries, select compatible architecture patterns, compile non-dispatching cross-plugin workflow graphs, and independently review architecture candidates or current changes. Domain plugins retain their decisions, Cascade AI Architect owns agent behavior, and the target host owns implementation and execution.
defaultPrompt: Design the software-system boundaries for this request.
Plan the smallest dependency-safe Cascade plugin workflow.
Review this architecture or change for boundary defects.
